content.short: Secure, manage, and exchange your crypto assets in one wallet.
content.description: Enjoy an enhanced user experience that emphasizes ease of use and financial sovereignty. Manage over 100 cryptocurrencies with real-time charts. Securely trade or stake your favorite coins in seconds. Featured Apps make it easy to earn interest on crypto. No account set up is required. Download Exodus and you're ready to go. Exodus mobile encrypts private keys and transaction data on your mobile device for your eyes only. Your data remains private - no registration or account setup required.
